title: Wall Street’s $359 billion-a-day repo market has found a use for blockchain
summary: Wall Street has found a use for blockchain that involves neither memecoins nor replacing the banking system. It's now helping institutions borrow billions between breakfast and lunch, usually because they have government bonds but not enough cash when a payment comes due.
